scripts.local: dotenv -e .env.local -- cross-env EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 sh -c 'expo prebuild --clean --platform android && expo run:android --device Pixel_8'
scripts.local:pixel9: dotenv -e .env.local -- cross-env EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 sh -c 'expo prebuild --clean --platform android && expo run:android --device Pixel_9 --no-bundler; for DEVICE in $(adb devices | grep "^emulator-" | cut -f1); do adb -s "$DEVICE" reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081; adb -s "$DEVICE" shell am force-stop com.anonymous.shoppinglist.local; adb -s "$DEVICE" shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "shoppinglist://expo-development-client/?url=http://127.0.0.1:8081" -p com.anonymous.shoppinglist.local; done'

scripts.build:apk:dev: dotenv -e .env.development -- cross-env EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 sh -c 'BUILD_NUMBER=${APP_BUILD_NUMBER:-200}; export APP_BUILD_NUMBER=$BUILD_NUMBER; expo prebuild --clean --platform android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ./SL-Dev-${BUILD_NUMBER}-v1.0.0.apk'
scripts.build:apk:prod: dotenv -e .env.production -- cross-env EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 sh -c 'BUILD_NUMBER=${APP_BUILD_NUMBER:-300}; export APP_BUILD_NUMBER=$BUILD_NUMBER; expo prebuild --clean --platform android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ./SL-Prod-${BUILD_NUMBER}-v1.0.0.apk'
scripts.env:check: for DEVICE in $(adb devices | awk '/emulator-/ {print $1}'); do AVD=$(adb -s "$DEVICE" emu avd name 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); PACKAGE=$(adb -s "$DEVICE" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep 'ResumedActivity:' | head -n 1 | sed -E 's/.* u0 ([a-zA-Z0-9._]+)\/.*/\1/'); case "$PACKAGE" in com.anonymous.shoppinglist.local) ENV=Local;; com.anonymous.shoppinglist.dev) ENV=Dev;; com.anonymous.shoppinglist) ENV=Prod;; *) ENV=Unknown;; esac; echo "$AVD ($DEVICE) : $ENV [$PACKAGE]"; done
